cd /workspace/dev && cat > stress2.py <<'EOF'
import sys, time, json, random, subprocess; sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/dev')
from harness import *
build()
random.seed(11)
def consistent(off, n): return bytes(((off+i)*7+3)&0xff for i in range(n))
traces=[]; total=0; hdr=0; frames=0
for t in range(64):
    events=[{'keys':['I','H','A']}]
    pn={'I':0,'H':0,'A':0}
    for e in range(127):
        bodies=[]
        sid=random.choice([0,4,8,12,2,6])
        off=random.randrange(0,4000)*8
        n=random.randrange(0,400)
        bodies.append(stream(sid, off, consistent(off,n)))
        coff=random.randrange(0,2000)*8; cn=random.randrange(0,300)
        bodies.append(crypto(coff, consistent(coff,cn)))
        bodies.append(bytes([2])+v(random.randrange(0,3000))+v(0)+v(0)+v(random.randrange(0,3000)))
        bodies.append(b'\x00'*random.randrange(1,10)+b'\x01')
        bodies.append(b'\x10'+v(random.randrange(0,10**6)))
        bodies.append(b'\x15'+v(sid)+v(0))
        bodies.append(b'\x18'+v(random.randrange(1,4))+v(0)+b'\x01'+bytes([random.randrange(256)])+b'\x22'*16)
        lvl=random.choice(['I','H','A'])
        body=b''.join(bodies); frames += 7
        wire=envelope(lvl, pn[lvl], body, width=random.choice([1,2,4]))
        pn[lvl]+=1; hdr+=1; total+=len(wire)
        events.append(datagram(wire, auth=(0,)*8))
    traces.append(trace(events))
print('events',sum(len(t['events']) for t in traces),'wire',total,'headers',hdr,'frames',frames)
data=json.dumps({'traces':traces}).encode(); print('input',len(data))
t0=time.time(); p=subprocess.run(['python3','/workspace/run.py','/workspace/tmp/classes'],input=data,capture_output=True); t1=time.time()
print('rc',p.returncode,'wall %.2f'%(t1-t0),'out',len(p.stdout),p.stderr.decode()[:300])
out=json.loads(p.stdout); r=out['traces'][0]
from collections import Counter
print(Counter(x['status'] for x in r['packets']))
print('streams',len(r['streams']),'used',r['used'],'opened',r['opened'],'ack',r['acknowledged'][2]['count'],r['acknowledged'][2]['intervals'])
print('peer_cids',len(r['peer_cids']),r['retire_prior_to'])
EOF
